notes.title: August 2024 Ver1.0.2 Fix Update Release Notes
notes.content:
The following items have been addressed/improved in this latest update:

-Fixed the issue where game software would not start after updating to the latest GeforceGameReady driver (560.70) and NVIDEA Studio driver (560.70).

If you have any problems with your environment, please email support with the following information and the issue.

*OS, CPU, system memory, GPU, video memory, display model number (please let us know as GPU settings such as tearing/stuttering may occur depending on synchronization and connection method) Version of the video card manufacturer's utility tool

notes.title: About not starting after updating to the latest GeForce driver.
notes.content:
Regarding the issue where the game does not start after updating to the latest NVIDIA GeForce driver

Dear Customer

Thank you for your support. This is Cosmo Machia Support.

We have received reports that after updating to the latest GeforceGameReady driver (560.70) and NVIDEA Studio driver (560.70),
game software will no longer start.

Our development team is currently investigating the issue, so please wait for a while until we can resolve the problem.

Even if you downgrade the driver, it will no longer start once it is installed.

It seems that the problem can only be resolved by restoring the environment that was working with a Windows backup. (This is not recommended as it involves risks.)

It does not seem to be a problem in environments other than the GeForce series, but the current workaround is to hold off on the driver update.

It will take some time to determine the cause, so we apologize for the inconvenience, and we appreciate your patience.

If the game does not start, could you please let us know the details of the situation so that we can investigate it?

・See OS version, CPU and GPU memory system details > System version information.
・GeForce Experience and GeForce Game Ready driver versions > Check the information in the NVIDIA tool.

Thank you in advance.

Cosmo Machia Support

notes.title: June 2024 Ver1.0.1 Correction Update Release Notes
notes.content:
The following items have been addressed/improved in this latest update.

-Fixed the issue where display colors were strange only with AMD video cards.

AMD Software 24.5.1 installed
Ryzen 5 3400G with Radeon Vega Graphics
Ryzen 5 PRO 4650G with Radeon Graphics
Radeon RX 6600 XT

We have verified the above and confirmed that the problem does not recur.

-We cannot guarantee that the product will work in all environments, as we have not verified it in all environments.

If you are experiencing problems in your environment, please email support with the following information and the problem:

*OS, CPU, system memory, GPU, video memory, display model number (please let us know as GPU settings may cause problems such as tearing/stuttering depending on synchronization and connection method) Version of the video card manufacturer's utility tool
